MineMenu 3.4.0 for **Minecraft Java 1.21.1** (Fabric): a reworked menu with search, favorites, a Command Palette and Safe Mode, three new pages (Build, Fun, Utility) and about 50 new hacks.

**Menu**: ★ Favorites, search, right-click any button for its settings / a key / a favorite, **Command Palette (Ctrl+K)**, themes, shareable profiles, Macros; hacks, keys and settings are remembered between sessions. **Safe Mode**: a hack that errors is switched off instead of crashing the game; two failed starts in a row → the next one keeps every hack off; Reset everything (with a backup).

**Player**: Freecam, Full Bright, Auto-Sprint, Double Jump, Dash (V), Scaffold, Lava Swim, Gravity Control, **Morph** (R power, U back), Phase, Remote Chest, 10 waypoints + Last Death.
**Combat**: Bow Aimbot, Lifesteal, Force Field, Thorns Aura, Mind Control (N), Trident Storm, Mob War, Boss Arena, Armor Loadouts.
**Build**: Selection Wand, Copy/Paste with preview, Rotate, Mirror, Fill, Clear, Undo/Redo, Schematics, Structures, Terrain Brush, Biome Painter, Gravity Gun (64×64×64 without freezing).
**Fun**: Chaos Mode, Lucky Blocks, Floor is Lava, Random Drops, Mob Swap, Meteor Strike, Tornado.
**Utility**: Minimap + big map (M), Info HUD, Light Level Overlay, Chunk Borders, Slime Chunks, Mob Health Bars, Macros.
**Items / World**: Item, Potion and Mob Creator, Inventory Snapshots, Duplicate, Auto-Sort, Loot Refill, Magnet Filter, Death Chest, Nuker.

Hacks now also work in a world you open to LAN (only for you, the host). On a multiplayer server they stay off and nothing is sent; only the Minimap (without mobs), Info HUD and Chunk Borders work there.

## Install

1. Install the [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for Minecraft **1.21.1**.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (1.21.1) and **`minemenu-3.4.0.jar`** (below) in your `.minecraft/mods` folder, replacing the old MineMenu jar.
